timestamp_derivation: After the room-identity contract, conflict detection and identity-based coverage were proven by five Go regressions and an end-to-end SQL proof; before the author timestamp of the commit that introduces this receipt. Per T0091, in the order T0108 requires.

gaps_closed.one_room_contract: The vacant observation path keyed rooms on a trimmed value while the occupied path also lowercased. On digit-only rooms the two agree, which is why it survived review; on 'A12' the same room counts twice and rooms_named exceeds the building, making a PARTIAL sweep look COMPLETE. roomKey is now the single contract for every identity in the connector.
gaps_closed.coverage_by_identity: Completeness was a count. A sweep naming the right NUMBER of the wrong rooms passed it. Coverage now stores room identities and completeness is a set difference against the inventory recent uncontradicted sweeps describe. Proven: a sweep naming 60 rooms of which 10 are not in the building is refused where a count passes it.
gaps_closed.conflict_detection: A room reported occupied AND empty inside one generation was invisible to a count. It now yields REFUSED_CONFLICTING_OBSERVATIONS, closes nothing, and the contradicted generation cannot contribute to the room inventory either.

sharers_preserved: Two reservations in one room remain fully supported: one identity, zero conflicts, two admitted events, two roster records. This is the case the original defect turned on.
known_tradeoff: A bogus sweep contributes its rooms to the inventory union for the lookback window, so reconciliation stays cautious for a few generations rather than immediately. It self-heals as the generation ages out, and erring toward refusing is correct for a mechanism that closes guests' stays.
standing_exception: docs/operations/STANDING_PMS_EXCEPTION_GO_UNKNOWN_STAY.md records the one departure this appliance cannot place: a LIVE Guest-Out of 2026-08-23 carrying a valid reservation for which no arrival was ever received. No stay is fabricated, the case is not hidden, and the two decisions that could resolve it are written down.
automatic_operation_preserved: pmsd still records coverage and reconciles on every complete published generation. Nothing added here requires an operator action.
